subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): classify model calls as client spans

question: Should this PR be reduced to the diagnostics-only span-kind fix, or are the broad gateway, mobile, and session/UI behavior removals an intentional coordinated change?
rationale: The current head was authored and pushed by the assigned maintainer, so the broad scope may be deliberate; the PR title, body, and provided proof do not establish that intent or demonstrate safe replacement behavior.

options.title: Reduce to diagnostics scope
options.body: Keep only the model-call span-kind implementation, its focused regression test, and matching OpenTelemetry documentation.

options.title: Sponsor a coordinated removal
options.body: Retain the broader changes only with explicit owner rationale, migration or compatibility coverage, and real proof for each affected client surface.

options.title: Split the broad cleanup
options.body: Move the unrelated gateway, mobile, and session/UI removals into separately reviewed changes with their own product context.

recommendation.title: Reduce to diagnostics scope
recommendation.body: Keep only the model-call span-kind implementation, its focused regression test, and matching OpenTelemetry documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the current head that introduced the expanded scope.
